recognize_zh: PML/RARA 雙色雙融合（DC-DF）探針間期 FISH：兩顆細胞各見 2 個黃色融合訊號、1 紅（PML）1 綠（RARA），即典型 2F1R1G 型態，代表 der(15) 與 der(17) 各有一個融合，符合 t(15;17) 急性前骨髓細胞白血病。
features: Interphase FISH with PML (orange) and RARA (green) dual-color dual-fusion probe on DAPI-counterstained nuclei
Both nuclei show two yellow/overlapping fusion signals, one separate orange, and one separate green signal (2F1R1G)
Fusion signals represent PML-RARA on der(15) and RARA-PML on der(17); single colors represent the normal chromosomes 15 and 17
Signals are discrete with minimal background
describe_en: Interphase FISH using a PML/RARA dual-color dual-fusion probe shows two nuclei, each with two fusion signals, one orange PML signal, and one green RARA signal (2F1R1G). This is the classic pattern of a balanced reciprocal translocation, with fusion signals on der(15) and der(17) and single-color signals on the normal homologs. Findings are consistent with t(15;17)(q24;q21) PML::RARA, diagnostic of acute promyelocytic leukemia when in the appropriate morphologic context. This finding warrants urgent communication because of the coagulopathy risk and the need for ATRA-based therapy.

ddx.vs: Three-way or insertional events give non-classic patterns such as 1F2R2G or 1F1R1G rather than 2F1R1G.
These lack PML-RARA fusion and require a RARA break-apart probe to detect.
Chance overlaps are single, occur in few cells, and are excluded by laboratory cutoffs, unlike reproducible two fusion signals per nucleus.
